nodes.label: Graphify Context Layer
nodes.rationale: A persistent on-disk knowledge graph queried for context instead of re-reading the codebase each session; additive, so when missing every role falls back to normal reading and the harness never depends on it.

nodes.label: Graph Freshness Maintenance
nodes.rationale: A stale graph misleads, so keep it current: the post-commit hook re-runs deterministic free AST extraction on code, while semantic doc extraction costs tokens and runs on demand via /graphify --update.
